concept: Small acts of service add up — helping doesn't have to be a big grand thing
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Tokkatsu-style everyday-service principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character does several small helpful things throughout a day, and by the end it's made a real difference
exercise.reflection_prompt: None of the character's actions were huge — why did they still matter?
exercise.practice: Student lists three small ways they could help someone today

assessment.success_marker: student names three specific, small, realistic actions
